instructions:
The principal wants a yes/no answer. Using ONLY the listed fields (refer to each as
latest("<ref>")), write a decision rule as a boolean expression with explicit thresholds, the conventional or
physical reason for each threshold, and short labels for yes and no. The rationale must hold on any day: do not
mention today's values in it. If an existing service already gives a
direct verdict or index, you may use it, but prefer rules that remain correct if one source is missing (use 'or' /
'and' deliberately). Do not invent fields. One or two rules at most.

questions.quantity: Overall verdict for today's daytime drying period (roughly 08:00-18:00 local), derived from the conditions below: no rain during the drying period and conditions that dry clothes reasonably (not too humid, some wind or sun).
questions.question: Is today a good day to dry laundry outside in Osaka?
questions.population: Osaka city, today, daytime hours when laundry would be hanging out

expr.description: boolean expression using latest("ref") over the given refs, comparisons, and/or/not, numbers

rules.question: Is today a good day to dry laundry outside in Osaka?
rules.expr: (latest("tenki_27100_3hours_html:laundry_index_today") == "大変よく乾く" or latest("tenki_27100_3hours_html:laundry_index_today") == "よく乾く" or (latest("met_2_0_compact:properties.timeseries.0.data.instant.details.relative_humidity") <= 70 and latest("met_2_0_compact:properties.timeseries.0.data.instant.details.cloud_area_fraction") <= 70)) and latest("met_2_0_compact:properties.timeseries.0.data.next_6_hours.details.precipitation_amount") < 0.5 and latest("met_2_0_compact:properties.timeseries.0.data.next_1_hours.details.precipitation_amount") < 0.2 and not (latest("jma_warning_270000_json:areaTypes.0.areas.0.warnings.0.status") != "解除" and latest("jma_warning_270000_json:areaTypes.0.areas.0.warnings.0.code") != "21")
rules.no_label: No – not a good day to hang laundry outside
rules.rationale: Laundry dries well when no rain falls during the drying period and the air is not too humid, with some sun or wind. The rule requires negligible forecast precipitation in the near term. It also requires either tenki.jp's laundry index to be in its top categories, or the Met.no forecast to show moderate humidity and limited cloud, so it still works if one source is missing. An active warning other than a mere strong-wind advisory (e.g. heavy rain, storm) vetoes the verdict.

thresholds.threshold: == 大変よく乾く or よく乾く
thresholds.why: The top tenki.jp categories mean fast drying.
Below about 70% RH, evaporation is efficient; above it drying slows markedly.
Mostly sunny or partly cloudy skies still give enough solar heating.
Under 0.5 mm in 6 hours is effectively dry; more would wet the laundry.
Negligible drizzle in the next hour.
An active warning other than a strong-wind advisory suggests severe weather.
